Please indicate your level of agreement to the statements below:
Blind Patriotism
  1. I would support my country right or wrong
Constructive Patriotism
  1. I oppose some U.S. policies because I care about my country and want to improve it
Possible responses range from Strongly agree (1) to Strongly disagree (9).
Source:
Schatz, R. T., Staub, E., & Lavine, H. (1999). On the varieties of national attachment: Blind versus constructive patriotism. Political Psychology, 20(1), 151-174.
